message.content: {"base_author": ["Terminology like 'intellectual property' is gobbledygook that confuses people and hides the real legal issues.", "No one should have the power to stop others from making copies of software.", "Users must have the freedom to modify software, as they do with physical tools like chairs or cars.", "Non-free software is unacceptable because it subjugates users by denying them control over their computing."]}
